title: 26日は「土用のうしの日」　今年はうなぎが安くなりそう
title_en: The 26th is the 'Day of the Ox in Midsummer'; This year, eel is likely to be cheaper.

sentences.jp: 26日は「土用のうしの日」　今年はうなぎが安くなりそう
sentences.en: The 26th is the 'Day of the Ox in Midsummer'; This year, eel is likely to be cheaper.
